name: crunch (legs on stability ball)
description: A crunch with your calves resting on a stability ball. The raised legs fix the hips and focus the work on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a stability ball and your knees bent at 90 degrees.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Keep your neck relaxed and the ball steady.
